measurement_audit.note: These are native policy calls only; offline replay is excluded. Measurement acceptance is not task success.

motion_adaptation_audit.interpretation: The plan explicitly removes historical heading change, rolls about current gripper local+X/world+Y from the vase left side, and reverses that roll for restoration. Actual241→373 rotation is dominated by positive localX while approach stays approximately fixed;393→439 reverses it. The successful version changed its current approach from early low roll to pretilt above-left and diagonal approach based on observed tracking, without changing frozen source.
motion_adaptation_audit.feedback_evidence: At the first30-degree attempt the policy reported vertical tracking offset, reversed upright, then pretilted45degrees clear above-left, approached at60degrees, held at85degrees, rolled beyond horizontal and held. It observed the cup empty, restored, set down, released and homed; independent native evaluator ended success=true at525steps.
motion_adaptation_audit.measurement_boundary: Native measure_rim accepted the cup atstep52; all six other rim fits failed. Policy-local calibrated oblique fits supplied the receiving opening and later cup-hand offset. Those are not native tool fit successes.

outcome_analysis.limits: One development success cannot establish heldout performance or isolate a RAG-only causal effect. Native task verdict is authoritative even though final policy text correctly did not claim access to all internal success conditions.
